explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified VAI 12 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the rocuronium bromide shortage on 2023-02-15 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.

The Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) plant that manufactures the Hikma-labeled vials used at Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside was inspected on 2023-02-03 and classified VAI, 12 days before the shortage posting.
That same plant also received a VAI classification after an inspection ending 2023-04-21, 65 days after the posting.
An earlier inspection ending 2020-03-06 was classified VAI, 1,076 days before the posting.
The Hospira, Inc. plant that supplies the alternate manufacturer option was last inspected with an NAI classification on 2025-02-07.
Corvale East has 7.1 days of the 5 mL presentation on hand, Corvale Lakeside has 28.5 days, and Corvale General has 19.2 days.

The rule-based best option is to transfer 13 vials of the 10 mg/mL, 5 mL presentation from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East to 9 days on hand while Corvale Lakeside retains two weeks of supply.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
